ASS00039 is a laboratory code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify tests measuring [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. It is specifically documented in the "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (*Atrieflimren i Danmark*) report published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), which outlines technical guidelines for calculating clinical quality indicators in national health registries [^src1]. 

In the context of atrial fibrillation diagnostics, ASS00039 is recognized as one of the valid laboratory codes that satisfy the criteria for a performed TSH measurement under clinical quality indicator 3 [^src1]. When calculating the numerator for this indicator, ASS00039 is grouped alongside several other national and local laboratory codes, including NPU27547, NPU04199, NPU04200, NPU03624, NPU 03578, DNK35895, ASS00136, and ASS00647 [^src1]. This standardized coding ensures that patients undergoing diagnostic workups for atrial fibrillation are correctly tracked for thyroid function assessments, which is a critical step in managing the condition and determining appropriate treatment pathways [^src1].
